title: pull-and-deploy reports success (exit 0) when deploy_pull_restart.sh fails: git index.lock collision left the VM on the old HEAD with no restart
owner: manager (re-owned 2026-11-26 by BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261126; was: manager (re-owned 2026-11-25 by BACKLOG-TRIAGE-W48; was: AM-OPS (session_01AFoLuJUGfpon2bN)
note: MEASURED 2026-11-11, system-action #24976 (deploy of #24936). The log shows 'fatal: Unable to create /home/ubuntu/ict-trading-bot/.git/index.lock: File exists' during the hard-reset to origin/main, then 'ERROR: deploy_pull_restart.sh exited 0', and the comment says completed with wrapper exit 0. The VM stayed on 0f1fe6d5b and the prop executors were not restarted, so merged != deployed went unseen. Fix: (1) propagate the real exit status, and red-flag when the post-deploy HEAD != origin/main; (2) serialise with ict-git-sync (flock on a shared lock) or retry the git step after a short wait when index.lock exists and no git process holds it. Retry dispatched as #24999 (or the next issue number).
